name: Pocket ni Koi o Tsumete
original_name: ポケットに恋をつめて
source:
The gender split in Sayahama-chou’s Kouchourinkai Gakuen is greatly imbalanced, with 2 boys for every 8 girls. However, it’s not like a harem situation for the boys since they are treated as nobodies. Faced with a dimming future, the boys decided to create an unofficial ‘hero club’ with the aim to become people that everyone will want to have around.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/03/01/march-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
